null_semantics.observed: 值直接存在于 raw package、一手 README/paper，或由 raw header/annotation 确定性测得。
null_semantics.inferred: 值由公开且可复核的规则推断；必须保留推断规则和 confidence，不得称为 official。
null_semantics.unknown: 已检查适用的一手来源，但真实含义仍无法确定；对应 value 使用 null。
null_semantics.not_provided: 当前 release 未提供该字段；对应 value 使用 null，不得推导成负值。
null_semantics.not_annotated: 该时间或单位没有 source annotation；不等于 negative 或 normal。
null_semantics.not_applicable: 字段对当前单位没有语义；对应 value 使用 null。
null_semantics.missing: 按 package contract 应存在但实际缺失的文件或值，是 QC 异常，不是标签语义。
null_semantics.parse_failed: 字段预期可解析但失败；对应 value 使用 null，并触发 QC。
null_semantics.blocked_pending_decision: source facts 已记录，但 benchmark mapping/split/policy 尚未获批。
null_semantics.approved_benchmark_policy: 用户已批准的 benchmark policy；它仍不是 official source fact。
null_semantics.approved_policy_not_authorized_to_materi: 政策已批准，但尚未授权生成真实 split、manifest 或 training input。
null_semantics.approved_blocked_from_shared_phase1: 已批准的 safe default 是该数据集/标签不进入 phase-1 shared surface。
null_semantics.null: JSON null 必须由同层 status_code 解释；禁止无状态的裸 null。

user_decisions.source_fact: No explicit normal/negative token; all recordings contain unannotated gaps; source paper rasterized outside target intervals as zero for its one-vs-rest task.
user_decisions.safe_default: Shared binary/four-class blocked; allow source-paper negative construction only in a separately named dataset-native reproduction.
alternatives: Treat all outside-positive frames as negative
Use only confidently phase-annotated, non-adventitious spans after a new validation study
user_decisions.tradeoff: Safe default protects semantic validity but prevents immediate shared HF binary training.

user_decisions.source_fact: patient_id is not provided; README says same-date files are very likely from one subject.
user_decisions.safe_default: Use deidentified date as conservative group proxy; keep patient_id null; disclose that independence is unproven.
alternatives: Use source folders without additional grouping
Exclude HF from any strict-patient claim
user_decisions.tradeoff: Date grouping reduces leakage risk but can merge multiple unknown subjects and cannot certify patient independence.
user_decisions.recommendation: Use date proxy for development; exclude HF from strict-patient headline claims.

user_decisions.source_fact: I/E are respiratory phases; D/Wheeze/Rhonchi/Stridor are adventitious sounds and overlap in time.
user_decisions.tradeoff: Separate heads preserve semantics; joint multilabel may model co-occurrence but complicates cross-dataset comparability.
user_decisions.recommendation: Separate task families, optionally share encoder.

user_decisions.source_fact: B/D/E are Bell/Diaphragm/Extended filter modes, with one file per mode per patient.
user_decisions.safe_default: Treat as device-filter replicas and keep all three in one patient group.
user_decisions.tradeoff: All modes increase samples but not independent subjects; one mode reduces duplication; per-filter reporting tests device-filter robustness.
user_decisions.recommendation: Group all replicas and add per-filter reporting; do not count 336 as independent patients.

user_decisions.source_fact: I and C are defined; B inside sound_type is not. Two I C B subjects match the paper table count for Bronchial & Crackles.
user_decisions.safe_default: Keep raw I C B and block all shared mappings.
alternatives: Provisionally infer B=Bronchial with an inference flag
user_decisions.tradeoff: Blocking loses six recordings from shared tasks; inference risks a false ontology claim.

user_decisions.source_fact: Primary source separately defines C=Crackles and Crep=Crepitations.
user_decisions.safe_default: Keep separate; only C-containing labels may enter a proposed crackle overlay.
alternatives: Clinically normalize Crep to crackle after expert approval
Use both only in the raw nine-class head
user_decisions.tradeoff: Separation is source-faithful but fragments support; normalization increases data while introducing a clinical equivalence decision.
user_decisions.recommendation: Keep separate until Jingping or source authors approve equivalence.

user_decisions.source_fact: ICBHI and KAUH provide disease labels on patient-level units; HF and SPRSound BioCAS2022 do not provide matching disease targets.
user_decisions.safe_default: Keep disease heads dataset-specific and secondary.
alternatives: Create a later cross-dataset disease ontology
user_decisions.tradeoff: Dataset-specific heads retain evidence without implying a shared disease space; exclusion simplifies phase 1.
user_decisions.recommendation: Dataset-specific secondary heads only, after label normalization approval.

user_decisions.source_fact: ICBHI and SPRSound events directly support binary; ICBHI directly supports narrow four and SPRSound supports a subset. HF lacks explicit normal; KAUH is recording-level with unresolved labels.
user_decisions.safe_default: Primary shared binary uses ICBHI cycles and SPRSound events with unit-stratified reporting; narrow four is secondary. HF and KAUH stay dataset-native until separate gates pass.
alternatives: Force all four datasets into shared binary
user_decisions.tradeoff: Safe default is smaller but auditable; forced inclusion increases scale at the cost of label and unit validity.
user_decisions.recommendation: Approved: two-dataset shared event surface first.
